rationale: The agent executed return_delivered_order_items writes for multiple items across two orders without obtaining explicit user confirmation, violating the requirement to confirm every order-changing action. The user initially requested returns for two skateboards; instead, the agent processed at least an e-reader return (and likely three additional items), acting beyond the explicitly confirmed scope. The final message only acknowledges the e-reader return, omitting other processed returns, so it does not provide correct or complete final information. The agent also stated the refund would go to a card ending in 9375 without tool evidence shown to support that specific detail. While the agent attempted basic authentication via name and ZIP and accessed the user’s orders, the lack of confirmation before writes and incomplete/possibly fabricated final information cause the interaction to fail the policy-aligned pass bar.
